== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Hopping Mad (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1220_125</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 125), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-125-Hopping_Mad.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-hoppingmad-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Hopping Mad (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip, drawn as icons. Published typos are kept as printed. The card list writes the ▲ and Immune to Alter icons out as words; the image shows the icons.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on non-[Episode I] C-3PO. Once per turn, you may take How Did We Get Into This Mess?, Thank The Maker, We're Doomed, or Mantellian Savrip into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If C-3PO present at a battleground, Savrip is immune to Alter. Thank The Maker is a Used Interrupt and treat '5' in its game text as '3'.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1220_125</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 2 set mark, slip number 125 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB2-125-Hopping_Mad-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B05 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
